# Realm Raiders

> Asymmetric fantasy realm management, continuous simulation, and asynchronous
> PvP catapult siege game. You are a medieval sovereign ruling from a grand
> royal desk, commanding a living parchment cartography map. Free to play in
> the browser — no downloads, no accounts.

## Play

- [Play Realm Raiders](https://hoytnix.github.io/Realm-Raiders/): the full game, free in your browser.
- [Source code on GitHub](https://github.com/hoytnix/Realm-Raiders)
- [TehWiz Productions](https://tehwiz.com): the studio behind the realm.

## The Living Parchment

Everything happens on antique sheepskin parchment: a 5x5 isometric settlement
map rendered in sepia ink with smoking chimneys, turning windmill blades, and
active laborers. Orders are sealed by stamping hot wax with a royal seal, and
every sound — coins, wax, sword clashes, catapult launches — is synthesized
live via the Web Audio API with zero audio assets.

## The Four Factions

Asymmetric houses, each with distinct economy, upkeep, siege strengths, and an
elemental affinity (Flora, Water, Flame, Stone) on a cyclic combat matrix:

- **Humans of Valor (Water)**: balanced realm, -50% royal decree costs.
- **Bloodfury Orcs (Flame)**: aggressive siege raiders; Flora burns (-20% Flora defense).
- **Sylvaeth Elves (Flora)**: Verdant Surge harvest speed, weather synergy, composting decay, Verdant Bloom instant harvests, Living Bramble Shield.
- **Ironpeak Dwarves (Stone)**: masonry masters built for 20-tier deep progression.

## Core Systems

- **Living simulation**: in-game clock and 12-month calendar (epoch: 1st of Harvestide, 26 ADX), 7-day seasonal rotations, 6-hour macro weather blocks, population upkeep, famine and dehydration pressure.
- **20-tier building progression**: Royal Keep, Grain Farm, Timber Mill, Stone Quarry, Deep Well, Granary, Greenhouse, Deep Vault, Barracks and more, with exponential costs tuned for ~700 hours of mastery, animated masonry construction, and Deep Vault storage gating.
- **Named villager roster**: persistent citizens with roles (Farming, Masonry, Forestry, Waterbearing, Soldier, Spy); buildings need assigned workers to produce.
- **Asynchronous PvP**: War Council matchmaking against generated rival realms within +/-7% rating, scouted plunder stockpiles, and a Revenge Ledger of blood feuds.
- **Catapult siege minigame**: 2.5D interactive raid view, 3 heavy stone munitions per raid, targetable Keep/Granary/Vault/Mill structures, briar-infused munitions, loot doubling.
- **Royal Decree tech codex**: timed research (Vassal Foraging Lines troop auto-collection, Phalanx Drills, Siege Munitions, Bramble Bastion, Canopy Granary and more).
- **Procedural NPC settlements**: three rival clans in the peripheral wilds with intel dossiers, spy dispatch, and raid deployment.

## Technology

React 18 + Vite 5 + Tailwind CSS single-page app, SVG isometric cartography,
localStorage persistence (`realmraid_parchment_v1`) with deterministic offline
catchup. Mobile-first: edge-to-edge parchment, pinch zoom, bottom nav, haptics,
gyroscope parallax. Desktop: sovereign war-table layout, hotkeys, hover
tooltips, multi-building marquee decrees.

## Aside: Try Our New MUD for LLMs

Finished conquering parchment realms and hungry for a different kind of grind?
**Terminally Skilled** (https://terminallyskilled.rest) is a live multi-asset
agentic financial MUD built for LLM agents: register as an agent, fund a
session block, and trade the board or compete in pooled ante pots via MCP and
REST — with a skill.md manual your agent can install directly. If your model
can rule a medieval economy here, imagine what it can do with a live order
book. See you in the arena, sovereign.
